name: davinci-resolve-lua-mcp
description: Control the free edition of DaVinci Resolve 21.1 from Claude through a Lua script that runs inside Resolve. macOS, no Studio licence, no network.
long_description: DaVinci Resolve 21.1 removed Python and external scripting from the free edition. This extension talks to Resolve through the one door left: a Lua script launched from Workspace > Scripts inside Resolve, which holds the live `resolve` object and executes Lua on behalf of the server. The server writes request files, the script answers through Fusion preferences; no network is involved. On first run the server copies its two Lua scripts into Resolve's user Utility scripts folder. Then, in Resolve, open a project and run Workspace > Scripts > resolve_mcp_bridge.

scripts_dir.title: Resolve user scripts folder
scripts_dir.description: Resolve's user Utility scripts folder. The two Lua scripts are copied here so they appear under Workspace > Scripts. Only this folder is ever written.

auto_install_bridge.title: Install the bridge scripts automatically
auto_install_bridge.description: Copy (and update) resolve_mcp_bridge.lua and claude_diag.lua into the scripts folder when the server starts.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where the request file, the lock and the server log live (created with mode 0700).

default_timeout_s.title: Default tool timeout (seconds)
default_timeout_s.description: How long a tool waits for the bridge before giving up, 1 to 300.

tools.name: resolve_status
tools.description: Whether the in-Resolve Lua bridge is running and reachable, why not, its session, the self-install outcome and, when alive, product, version, edition, page and project.

tools.name: run_lua
tools.description: Run a Lua 5.1 chunk inside DaVinci Resolve with the live resolve object; returns its first return value as JSON plus captured prints and errors.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Overview of the open project: name, page, database, frame rate, resolution, timeline count, root-bin counts and the current timeline.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects in the current project-manager folder with dates and notes; marks the open one.

tools.name: list_timelines
tools.description: Every timeline of the open project with unique id, frame range and track counts; marks the current one.

tools.name: list_media_pool_clips
tools.description: Clips in one Media Pool bin with path, duration, fps, resolution, type, frames and colour; paginated.

tools.name: get_timeline_items
tools.description: Items on one track of the current timeline with type, frames, source frames, enabled state and file path; paginated.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add a marker to the current timeline at a frame relative to the timeline start; returns the stored marker.

tools.name: delete_markers
tools.description: Delete every marker of one colour, or all markers, from the current timeline; requires confirm=true.

tools.name: set_current_timeline
tools.description: Make the named timeline the current one; an unknown name lists the known timelines.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Load the named project, saving the open one first by default; an unknown name lists the known projects.

tools.name: render_current_timeline
tools.description: Queue and start a render of the current timeline into an existing directory, optionally from a named preset; returns the job id.

tools.name: get_render_status
tools.description: Status, completion percentage and error of one render job, plus whether Resolve is rendering.

tools.name: stop_bridge
tools.description: Ask the in-Resolve bridge loop to exit cleanly; it must be relaunched from Workspace > Scripts afterwards.

tools.name: scripting_api_docs
tools.description: Search Blackmagic's shipped Resolve scripting reference (.pyi signatures, README sections, CHANGELOG) with file and line; flags deprecated and unsupported calls.
